_comment: Multi-Phase Cambridge Listening Exam Template — Each phase plays a specific MM:SS to MM:SS clip from a YouTube video (or uploaded audio) and grades that phase immediately. Final assignment score = average of all phases.
title: B2 Listening Full Mock (Parts 1 & 2)
instructions: Complete each Listening part in order. After each part, your answers will be checked immediately before moving to the next part.

phases.title: Part 1 — Multiple Choice Extracts
phases.instructions: Listen to the clip from 00:30 to 03:15 and answer Questions 1–2.

phases.title: Part 2 — Sentence Completion
phases.instructions: Listen to the clip from 03:20 to 06:00 and complete each gap.

questions.prompt: Why did the speaker decide to change careers?
options: To spend more time working outdoors
